en: A black‑and‑white postcard with two historical industrial views. The upper image shows a large factory complex with a tall smokestack beside railway tracks. The lower image is a broader view of an old mill or factory settlement by a river, with multiple buildings, water channels, and surrounding countryside. Below the upper image is Swedish text reading "Från det gamla Ödeborg".
